operation_id.description: Stable D004 operation identifier. Must match manifest filename stem.

facets.description: Applicable facet rows for this operation, including exactly one universal valid-path row. Closure validator MUST reject duplicate name values even when other fields differ; JSON Schema cannot express that constraint.

evidence.description: Required when status is closed. Names exact passing production CLI proof.
